newsitem.title: GREECE: DRACHMA FALLS VS $, RISES VS ECU AT QUIET FIX.
newsitem.headline: DRACHMA FALLS VS $, RISES VS ECU AT QUIET FIX.

text.p: The dollar set a record high against the drachma at the central bank's fixing, settling at 282.14 from 281.500 on Wednesday, but the drachma registered a gain against the ecu at 309.85 from Wednesday's 309.920.

"Ecu/drachma would have settled between 309.90/95 at the fixing if it were not for some very light selling by the central bank that pushed below 309.90," a forex dealer said. "The Bank of Greece showed that it wanted ecu/drachma on a downward course."
The dollar posted new gains on the back of its strong performance against the mark in the last few days, dealers said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
